projects.name: HPR Human Pattern Recorder
projects.description: HPR is a compiled, offline, zero-account activity tracker for Linux (Wayland/X11) and Windows, written in C++23. It polls the active window every 50ms and builds a complete timestamped log of every window switch, every minute, every day. Binary is ~5MB, RAM footprint 8-27MB — compared to ActivityWatch at 200MB+ and RescueTime which requires a cloud account. No accounts, no subscriptions, no telemetry by default. Ships with a sandboxed Lua 5.4 extension engine with function overriding API that lets extensions intercept 24+ core C++ functions, native browser tab tracking and IDE project tracking without any browser or editor extensions, cross-day pattern analysis across 9 metrics, a runtime theme system requiring no recompilation, and HPR Store — a community extension and theme registry with 1-click install from inside the app. Supported on Hyprland, GNOME, KDE Plasma 6, Cinnamon, niri, and Windows 10/11. As of September 2026: 450+ organic downloads across Linux and Windows in under 4 months, daily installs, 37 GitHub stars, zero paid promotion. One real user testimonial: 'HPR is an excellent tool for time management on Linux! It far outweighs any other option available and is developing very quickly!' — dotsupershow, Niri user.
